name: Ioun Stone (Greater Absorption)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Absorbs a spell of level 8 or lower aimed only at you (50 levels, then it burns out).
text: Once you are attuned, toss this stone upward as a Magic action and it circles your head 1d3 feet away, granting its benefit while it orbits; snatching it back out of the air takes an action. The stones bear the name of Ioun, a deity of knowledge and prophecy worshipped on some worlds. Benefit: it soaks up any spell of level 8 or below that targets you alone, and burns out once it has absorbed 50 spell levels in total.
